finding: The semantic source defined finish(v : VerifiedEffectReceipt) -> DoneReceipt with only v.stage == VERIFIED while the same module declared verified_outcome_requires_provenance_bound_reentry_before_done. EffectStage did not contain REENTERED even though the authoritative runtime/UnifiedDB uses REENTERED as the causal completion transition.
impact: ClayCode semantic authority permitted a VERIFIED -> DONE shortcut that was weaker than the V17.2/V17.2.1 persistence contract. Database enforcement alone therefore could not establish end-to-end semantic closure.
repair: add REENTERED to EffectStage and FINALIZATION_PENDING to RecoveryDecision
introduce opaque EffectReentryReceipt binding exact verified-outcome, causal-credit, admitted-delta and reentry hashes
require trusted provenance reentry before finish
change finish to require both VerifiedEffectReceipt and matching current EffectReentryReceipt
make verified_receipt_alone_cannot_mint_done, done_requires_reentered_receipt and reentry_receipt_binds_exact_verified_outcome explicit invariants
discriminator: runtime/frank_effect_lifecycle_v1/claycode_frontend_probe.py compiled by current bundled ClayCode frontend + structural TypedIR bridge on target VPS
